news.title: The Next Chapter Begins for Butler’s Class of 2026
news.summary_en: More than 1,500 graduates turned their tassels at Hinkle Fieldhouse on Friday, May 8, as Butler University celebrated the Class of 2026 during its annual Commencement ceremony.
